purpose: Exact read-only Ghidra invocations for the five upstream clock-selection export passes, plus the Ghidra-independent verification path.

toolchain.java_home_required: Without exporting JAVA_HOME, analyzeHeadless aborts with 'Unable to locate a Java Runtime' / 'Unable to prompt user for JDK path, no TTY detected'.

safety_flags.readOnly: opens the existing project read-only; no changes written back
safety_flags.noanalysis: does not run auto-analysis; exports instruction rows already present in the project
safety_flags.script_sha_gate: ExportSensorDiff.java refuses to run unless currentProgram.getExecutableSHA256() == 51531576fd31af96f7239b71d26e1f175815f5cb21dbe9ab305fa9a33cc6a891
safety_flags.range_targets: a start:end target dumps only already-decoded instructions in that address range; it never disassembles or mutates the program
safety_flags.no_execution: no firmware executed; no device/account/API/network access

passes.name: pass2
passes.note: 08010bfa and 08010c72 resolve to function=none because the retained project has no function body there; pass3 uses a range export for that area.

passes.name: pass3
passes.note: The divider-table range export is intentionally empty: it is a data table with no decoded instructions; the table bytes are asserted directly by the verification script.

passes.name: pass5
passes.note: Confirms the two undecoded dispatch callees have no instructions at their addresses.

command_template: export JAVA_HOME="/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; "$HEADLESS" "$GHIDRA_PROJECT_DIR" NonUsbSensor -process firmware-sensor-g0.bbin -readOnly -noanalysis -scriptPath "$SCRIPT_DIR" -postScript ExportSensorDiff.java "$OUT_DIR" <targets...>

ghidra_independent_path.statement: All published byte-level claims can be re-verified from the retained pass1..pass5 exports plus the frozen BBIN. The Ghidra project lives in a local research directory outside the delivery and is NOT required to audit the published conclusions; it is only needed to regenerate the exports.

inputs_not_in_delivery: The NonUsbSensor.gpr project in ~/Downloads (working artifact, not part of the frozen evidence bundle)
Ghidra 12.1.4 and OpenJDK 21 installed on the analysis host
